name: HackTool - SharpMove Tool Execution
description: Detects the execution of SharpMove, a .NET utility performing multiple tasks such as "Task Creation", "SCM" query, VBScript execution using WMI via its PE metadata and command line options.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\SharpMove.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:SharpMove.exe) OR (process.command_line:*computername\=* AND (process.command_line:(*action\=create* OR *action\=dcom* OR *action\=executevbs* OR *action\=hijackdcom* OR *action\=modschtask* OR *action\=modsvc* OR *action\=query* OR *action\=scm* OR *action\=startservice* OR *action\=taskscheduler*)))
